# OSSLLMAPI

> OSSLLMAPI is a modified version of freellmapi by Zelvior Labs: one OpenAI-compatible `/v1` API in front of the free tiers of 87 LLM providers and 1,313 free model endpoints — about 10.1 billion free tokens a month — with encrypted key storage, per-key usage tracking, automatic failover, and chat, embedding, image and audio endpoints. Free and open source (MIT).

## What it is

- **One API, every free LLM**: 87 free LLM providers, 1,313 free model endpoints, behind a single OpenAI-compatible `/v1` base URL (`http://localhost:3001/v1` by default).
- **OpenAI-compatible surface**: chat completions, embeddings, image generation and audio, plus an MCP server — existing OpenAI SDK code works unchanged.
- **Router intelligence**: every request is routed to the best available model from your fallback chain; when a provider is rate-limited or over its free-tier cap, the next provider takes the request automatically.
- **Encrypted keys**: provider keys are encrypted at rest; clients only ever see one unified API key minted in the dashboard.
- **Per-key budgets**: token usage is tracked per key against every provider's free-tier cap.
- **Self-updating catalog**: the router updates its model catalog from a signed feed. OSSLLMAPI is free and has no paid plan.

## Platforms

Desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux; Android APK; iOS IPA; Docker image (ghcr.io/ossllmapi); CLI on npm. Downloads: https://github.com/zelvior/ossllmapi/releases/latest

## Install

Point any OpenAI-compatible client at `http://localhost:3001/v1` with the unified key from the dashboard. Documentation: https://github.com/zelvior/ossllmapi/blob/main/docs/en/README.md

## Pricing

Free (MIT, self-hosted). OSSLLMAPI has no paid plan. The paid plan at https://freellmapi.co belongs to Tashfeen Ahmed, author of the original freellmapi.
